title: Patch: Starfleet Commander and Preemptive Strike still Discover a War Doctrine when a fused Cry asks during the launch
notes: R5106000: S #137 Starfleet Commander's Cry and S #176 Preemptive Strike read their Dormant Starship once, as the text begins (for_each_card's memo, R113), and build the launch and the Discover as one part from that read (c137_firststrike_capability::launch_then_discover, which both run). Before, the hook read dormant_starship_of each time the list was built: when a fused Cry asked during the launch (S #40 Poison Capsule's placement), the list paused after awaken, and its rebuild after the answer found the Starship launched, built nothing, and lost the Discover. Each card's script_before_launch_read_once keeps the old read, keyed by this fragment, so replays of every version before this one fold under it (R4779000). The change shows only when a fused piece's Cry asks during the launch, so the fragment claims no --plays; the kept scripts are its claim (R4844000).

player.title: War Doctrines after a Starship launch that asks
fixes: Starfleet Commander and Preemptive Strike now let you Discover a War Doctrine even when a piece's Cry asks you something as the Starship launches, such as where Poison Capsule's counters go.
